question: What does the RareCloud cart inside console.rarecloud.io price the Micro KVM at, and does the cart print a renewal price different from the order price?
why: the order page console.rarecloud.io/deploy?type=server served a sign-in form on every route tried on 2026-11-07 (broker read, 17 pinned providers, raw fetch), so the cart's own prices are unverified: behind a sign-up; the public pricing feed /data/whmcs-pricing.json carried the plan prices instead
